# Eversign

Xodo Sign is a cloud-based digital signature solution that allows users to sign, send, and manage documents online.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/eversign/.

## Actions

- **Create Document**: Create a new document for signature.
- **Create Template**: Create a new template.
- **List Documents** (read-only): List documents for a business.
- **List Templates** (read-only): List templates for a business with optional pagination.
- **Delete Document or Template**: Delete a document or template by its hash.
- **Get Bulk Jobs List** (read-only): Retrieve a list of bulk jobs for a business.
- **Get Document Audit Log** (read-only): Retrieve the audit log for a document.
- **List Businesses** (read-only): Retrieve a list of businesses associated with your account.
- **Reassign Signer**: Reassign a signer to a new person.
